scope: Shared Reader search foundation only; no module/BPF lookup or pscallstack acceptance
limitations: Pinned node[index] pointer-size container subtraction differs from actual rb_node stride; preserved with coordinates
Unreadable nodes, malformed/absent metadata, invalid pointers, cycles, bounds, cancellation and callback failures are explicit errors rather than silent no-match
Callback unavailable/None is represented as an explicit error by callers; empty trees still require valid declared layouts
No real modern-kernel positive, source-specific module/BPF comparator, live acquisition or full-plugin acceptance
Synthetic big-endian test only; package does not persist evidence itself
